hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v pre-commit >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] && [ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; out=$(pre-commit run --files "$f" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
